title: StudioBrain Template Metadata Schema
description: Template-level metadata in the YAML frontmatter of a *_TEMPLATE.md file (SBAI-15043): the type id, category, icon/colour, per-field configuration and browse views. Entity field values in a template are placeholders and are not checked here; per-type schemas (<entity_type>.json) check real entity instances. A user-defined type (any slug) validates against this schema with no layout and no per-type schema.

ui_icon.description: Lucide icon name shown in the sidebar and type pickers.

field_config.description: Per-field configuration keyed by field name. `type` is the semantic data type (spec section 2); `widget` names the editor widget and is linted against schemas/registry/widget-ids.json.

type.description: Semantic field type. Known: string, text, integer, number, float, boolean, date, datetime, image, gallery, tags, reference, references, url, email, color, markdown, rating, json, enum, array, object. Open: unknown types pass and fall back to the sample value.

widget.description: Editor widget id (canonical id from schemas/registry/widget-ids.json, or plugin:<plugin>:<widget>).

unit.description: Display unit for numbers, e.g. km/h.

options.description: Allowed values: plain strings or {value, label} objects.

oneOf.description: {value, label}, or a palette entry such as {label, hex}.

reference_type.description: Entity type slug (or comma-separated slugs) a reference field points at.
